sourceSpace: glTF right-handed Y-up, meters; muscle translation retained separately

muscle.description: Right vastus lateralis with femur and patella context; original surface topology retained.

fascicle.description: 37 representative fiber segments, perimysium window and capillary segments; 400 µm nominal fascicle diameter.

fiber.description: Representative 240 µm muscle-fiber segment: opened sarcolemma, packed striated myofibrils, nuclei, mitochondria and adjacent capillary.

sarcomere.description: Cropped representative sarcomere lattice: fixed-length thick and thin filaments, two Z discs and an M line. Manual length-controlled kinematics, not a force or biochemical simulation.

entities.name: Perimysium
entities.description: Connective sheath opened along a longitudinal teaching window.

entities.name: Capillary segments
entities.description: Representative longitudinal capillary segments; no vascular connectivity or perfusion solution.

entities.name: Sarcolemma
entities.description: Representative 50 µm fiber with a longitudinal inspection window; only a 240 µm segment is shown.

entities.name: Striated myofibrils
entities.description: Representative packed myofibrils. Painted repeats illustrate sarcomeres; filaments and contraction are not simulated.

entities.name: Peripheral myonuclei
entities.description: Illustrative peripheral nuclei in a multinucleated skeletal muscle fiber.

entities.name: Peripheral mitochondria
entities.description: Representative organelles; density and ATP production are not measured or simulated.

entities.name: Adjacent capillary
entities.description: Opened representative capillary beside the fiber; geometry is not a registered vascular domain.

entities.name: Erythrocytes
entities.description: Representative biconcave cells inside the capillary; their positions are illustrative.

entities.name: GLUT4 display sites
entities.description: Representative display markers; geometry and marker count are not molecular structures or measured transporter inventory.

entities.name: Thick filaments · myosin
entities.description: Central bipolar filaments with sparse illustrative heads. Filament length stays fixed during sliding; no ATP or cross-bridge kinetics.

entities.name: Thin filaments · left Z disc
entities.description: Actin-rich filaments anchored to this Z disc. Translate toward the M line without changing filament length. Troponin and tropomyosin are unresolved.

entities.name: Z disc · left
entities.description: Representative cross-linked anchoring lattice marking this sarcomere boundary. Not a resolved alpha-actinin structure.

entities.name: Thin filaments · right Z disc
entities.description: Actin-rich filaments anchored to this Z disc. Translate toward the M line without changing filament length. Troponin and tropomyosin are unresolved.

entities.name: Z disc · right
entities.description: Representative cross-linked anchoring lattice marking this sarcomere boundary. Not a resolved alpha-actinin structure.

entities.name: M line
entities.description: Representative links at the sarcomere midpoint, anchoring the thick-filament array; remains fixed during symmetric sliding.
